notes.title: [Demo Updates] Quality Update Part 1 is live
notes.notes:
Quality Update Part 1 for the Demo is Live!

Tutorial Levels
The tutorial levels are now available!
Players can gradually master the core combat mechanics and rules through three concise tutorial levels, learning the game's foundational gameplay.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619050/03cf5490a8a57fff7f1946780774b0f9ed28395b.png

Talent Skill Update
Each character has received new Talent Skills—more powerful but with stricter activation conditions. Use the character's cards strategically to charge these skills faster!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619050/856907acd1264d0c171eaebd47580bfe7548afcb.png

Card Art
Spiced up the card art! All playable cards now feature updated thumbnails for better visual clarity.
Additionally, persistent effects requiring attention are now marked in the top-right corner of cards, ensuring quicker information access.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619050/5a0704ffbfb7fe54fd3abfe173494e201235b81e.png

Along with numerous fixes and reworks for cards and buff effects—dive in and explore!
Part 2 of the update, launching during the June 9 Steam Next Fest, will introduce new enemies and character card slots!
